significance: Confirms iOS Simulator E2E is feasible — no mobile_scanner/MLKit arm64 blocker (neither app uses camera QR scanning).
NOT_launch_evidence: This is a BUILD only. Bundle kernel_blob.bin contains the production host string literal (the String.fromEnvironment default const), so static analysis cannot prove runtime isolation — a deployed-Sandbox runtime E2E matrix is required. Apps remain QUARANTINED until integration_test suites run on the simulator against deployed Sandbox with registered evidence (docs/quality/MOBILE_E2E_REQUIREMENTS.md).
